title: land-order@1 (gate-rules@1)
description: The order the auto-lander lands finished builds / PRs in. default = closest-to-main first; brett = a hand set it and it is kept as is. New PRs append at the bottom, merged / closed ones drop out.

rev.description: +1 on every change, by hand or by reconcile

source.description: default = the engine's sort (behind main ascending, then line position); brett = a hand set it

updatedBy.description: who last changed it: brett, a session name, or empty for the engine

id.description: pr-<n> when the PR exists, else build-<id> (landing-line@1 entry id)

pr.description: the PR number, 0 while there is none yet

behind.description: commits behind main when known: the default sort key

migratedFrom.description: set once when the order was first built from the merge queue or the landing line
